title: Lob Mechanics (Michelle Grogan)
style: progressive trance 130bpm female whisper vocal tribal drums djembe congas taiko horns brass stabs animal calls bird whoop wolf howl ambient pads English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Whisper intro]
Read the line read the line
They are tight to the kitchen
High arc is the answer
Deep is the play

[Whisper verse]
Load the legs deep low
Paddle face open forty five
Low to high swing path
Grip pressure four out of ten

Contact in front of the body
Lift from the legs not the arm
Shoulder rolls under the ball
Wrist quiet at contact

[Tribal drop chant]
Lift the ball lift the ball
Deep and high deep and high
Vamos arriba pa lante
Lift the ball lift the ball

[Whisper verse]
Apex twenty feet above
Landing zone the back line
Two feet inside the baseline
Over their shoulder reach

Follow through high to the sky
Return to ready slow
Move forward to the line
Breath out and reset eyes

[Tribal drop chant]
Lift the ball lift the ball
Deep and high deep and high
Vamos arriba pa lante
Lift the ball lift the ball

[Whisper outro]
Deep arc
Read first
Deep arc
Read first
